Earlier scenes:
(none)

This scene:
古代的时候，一个男孩子跟他的妈妈住在中国。他叫孟子。他们住在墓地的旁边，所以孟子老是祭拜。孟子不是祭拜，就是跟朋友聊天。他很喜欢他的城市，但是城市有才两个学校，都很小。

The teacher's corrections on this scene (student words：her correction, her note):
- 古代的时候：在古代
- 但是城市有才两个学校：这个城市，只有

The system's feedback items:
1. [Grammar & Vocabulary, error] 古代的时候：在古代，the original repeats two time expressions with the same meaning; use one time expression only. [vocab list]
2. [Grammar & Vocabulary, error] 城市有才两个学校：城市里只有两所学校，use “只有” to express a limited number, and use the classifier “所” for schools. [teacher rule: zhiyou_caiyou] [rule: measure_word]
3. [Coherence: reference, error] Coherence (Reference): 一个男孩子跟他的妈妈住在中国。他叫孟子：一个叫孟子的男孩子跟他的妈妈住在中国，introduce the character’s name in the first mention instead of using a pronoun and naming him only in the next sentence. [rule: character_introduction_first_mention]
4. [Coherence: reference, error] Coherence (Reference): 孟子不是祭拜，就是跟朋友聊天：他不是祭拜，就是跟朋友聊天，after the recent mention of the same character, use a pronoun rather than repeating the name. [rule: redundancy_delete]
5. [Coherence: reference, error] Coherence (Reference): 他很喜欢他的城市：他很喜欢自己住的城市，use “自己的” when the possessor is the same person as the subject, and name the city more clearly on its first mention. [teacher rule: ziji_possessor]

items.reason: 古代 and 的时候 are redundantly combined here; 在古代 is correct.
只有两所学校 correctly fixes 才有 and the classifier, but 城市里 does not make the previously unintroduced specific city into 这个城市 as the teacher required.
The teacher's first-mention rule requires introducing the boy with his name rather than naming him only in the following sentence.
孟子 was just mentioned, so the teacher's reference rule requires the close pronoun 他.
他的城市 is already a clear and acceptable reference here, so changing it to 自己住的城市 is an unnecessary rewording.
